title: List of conspiracy theories — Flat Earth
text:
Title: List of conspiracy theories — Flat Earth

Flat Earth theory first emerged in 19th-century England, despite the Earth's spherical nature having 
been known since at least the time of Pythagoras. It has in recent years been promoted by American software consultant 
Mark Sargent through the use of YouTube videos. Flat-earther conspiracy theorists hold that planet Earth is not a sphere, 
and that evidence has been faked or suppressed to hide the fact that it is instead a disc, or a single infinite plane. 
The conspiracy often implicates NASA. Other claims include that GPS devices are rigged to make aircraft pilots wrongly 
believe they are flying around a globe.
